caption: The page Update hide shipping methods rule after saving: the toast Saved! Please wait 1 min then Test checkout, the yellow banner You are on free Development plan, the rule name Hide Standard shipping for all orders and the status choice Testing, Active (selected) and Deactivated; the store name and an example email address in the Testing text are hidden.

The Checkout rules list with 1 Active, the welcome card at 0 of 2 tasks complete and one row: Hide Standard shipping for all orders, Status Active, Type Shipping, Subtype Hide, Activated on November 17, 2026; the store name is hidden.

The Billing page with the switch Monthly or Annual (Get 2 months free) and the cards Starter $4.99 (Only 2 rules allowed), Advanced $12.99 marked Most popular (up to 5 shipping, 5 payment, 5 validation, 5 discount and 1 cart rule) and Premium $29.99 (up to 25 of each and 1 cart rule, with an asterisk), each with FREE TRIAL FOR FIRST 5 DAYS; the store name is hidden.

The lower part of the Billing page after the click on Select plan for Starter: Select plan buttons on all three cards with the Premium one greyed out, and the Free plan at $0.00 (Rules can be tested using testing status) marked Current plan; the store name and a name in the merchant review text at the bottom are hidden.
